title: Insurance Claim Services Contents Storage Coverage and Storage Extension Requests
content:
**Terms.** The carrier pays contents storage only through the approved storage end date recorded on the claim file; the end date is set or moved only when the carrier confirms it in writing. The claim file must be in approved status when a storage extension is requested. Extensions may be requested only on tiers that allow them, for no more than the tier's storage extension maximum beyond the current approved end date, and only while a contents job of the file is in storage. A storage extension request must be submitted at least the tier's storage extension lead days before the approved storage end date. A request submitted later is not sent, and storage after the approved end date is billed to the customer under the contents storage rules.

These Insurance Claim Services terms govern carrier-paid contents storage and every storage extension request. Whether extensions are allowed, the extension maximum and the lead days are each tier's own figures.

## Conditions of an extension request

| Condition | Evidence |
|---|---|
| claim file in approved status | the claim file's status on the system record |
| the tier allows extensions | the tier's figures |
| end date asked for is no more than the tier's maximum beyond the current approved end date | the approved storage end date on the claim file |
| a contents job of the file is in storage | the contents job linked to the file |
| submitted at least the lead days before the approved storage end date | the approved storage end date on the claim file |

## Hypothetical illustration (60-day maximum, 14 lead days, approved end date 30 September)

- A request submitted on 16 September, 14 days before the end date, asking for 29 November (60 days beyond) meets the lead and the maximum.
- A request submitted on 17 September is late and is not sent; storage after 30 September is billed to the customer under the contents storage rules.
- A request asking for 30 November exceeds the maximum by one day.
- The end date moves only when the carrier confirms the new date in writing.
